source: RFC 0007 §5.7 (maintainer decision 2026-11-22: what can be computed is not configured; the properties review, items 8-12)
statement: The control plane's cadences and limits are constants or computed, and no property sets them: every instance tries to reclaim revisions every hour, and the one that holds the pass's lease does it, under that lease: it alone reads the open changes of every document, where every instance read them each hour (DR1-E-2); a record not on a revision chain, or a change listed but never written, is removed once it is one reclaim pass old, never younger, since a record whose first write is in flight is not an orphan; the open shadow windows are looked at every fifteenth of `cosec.control.shadow.min-duration`, between a quarter of a second and a minute, so a window closes at most one pass after it could; an instance writes its shadow reports and status every sixth of the status's life (10 s), and no oftener than a fifth of the shortest life of a window nor than a second, so it is never older than the status that makes it counted; the control routes read a body of at most the document cap and 2 MB (10 MB), so raising the cap raises the limit. The starter says once at startup what it derived and from what.
guards: control:ControlDerivedTest#an orphan is removed only once it has outlived a whole reclaim pass
control:ControlDerivedTest#the shadow pass is a fifteenth of the least a window lives, within a quarter second and a minute
control:ControlDerivedTest#a window never closes later than one pass after it could
runtime:ShadowReporterDerivedIntervalTest#the interval is never longer than a sixth of the status's life, so an instance is never uncounted for it
spring-boot:ControlServicePortTest#a host that runs the control plane says once what it derived
control:ControlMaintenanceTest#only the instance holding the reclaim lease reads the open changes
